"""Generate Fig 2 / Fig 3 / Fig 4 for solver-trace-ablation paper."""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
import os

OUTDIR = '/root/solver-trace-ablation/figures'
os.makedirs(OUTDIR, exist_ok=True)

# ---------- Global style (EMNLP two-column) ----------
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 10,
    'axes.labelsize': 9,
    'xtick.labelsize': 8,
    'ytick.labelsize': 8,
    'legend.fontsize': 8,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.6,
})

# Okabe-Ito colorblind-friendly palette
C_PR        = '#0072B2'  # deep blue
C_ISR       = '#D55E00'  # vermilion
C_H1        = '#CC79A7'  # pink
C_H7        = '#E69F00'  # orange
C_GENUINE   = '#009E73'  # bluish green
C_OTHER     = '#999999'  # grey
C_EXEC      = '#56B4E9'  # sky blue
C_STA       = '#D55E00'  # vermilion


def save_both(fig, name):
    pdf = os.path.join(OUTDIR, f'{name}.pdf')
    png = os.path.join(OUTDIR, f'{name}.png')
    fig.savefig(pdf)
    fig.savefig(png, dpi=300)
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f'Saved: {pdf}')
    print(f'Saved: {png}')


# =====================================================
# Fig 2: ISR Collapse Trajectory
# =====================================================
def fig2_isr_collapse():
    steps = np.array([100, 500, 1000])
    prove_rate = np.array([32.0, 93.0, 96.0])   # %
    isr_star   = np.array([0.642, 0.132, 0.003])

    fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.4, 2.7))

    # Highlight collapse zone (after 500 steps where ISR* << 0.1)
    ax1.axvspan(500, 1000, alpha=0.12, color='#D55E00', zorder=0,
                label='Structural collapse')

    # PR on left axis
    l1 = ax1.plot(steps, prove_rate, 'o-', color=C_PR, markersize=6,
                  label='Prove Rate', zorder=3)
    ax1.set_xlabel('Training steps')
    ax1.set_ylabel('Prove Rate (%)', color=C_PR)
    ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=C_PR)
    ax1.set_ylim(0, 105)
    ax1.set_xticks(steps)
    ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.25, axis='y', zorder=1)

    # ISR* on right axis
    ax2 = ax1.twinx()
    ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    l2 = ax2.plot(steps, isr_star, 's--', color=C_ISR, markersize=6,
                  label='ISR*', zorder=3)
    ax2.set_ylabel('ISR*', color=C_ISR)
    ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=C_ISR)
    ax2.set_ylim(0, 0.75)

    # Annotate the scissor-gap endpoints
    for x, y in zip(steps, prove_rate):
        ax1.annotate(f'{y:.0f}', (x, y), textcoords='offset points',
                     xytext=(0, 7), ha='center', fontsize=7, color=C_PR)
    for x, y in zip(steps, isr_star):
        ax2.annotate(f'{y:.3f}', (x, y), textcoords='offset points',
                     xytext=(0, -12), ha='center', fontsize=7, color=C_ISR)

    # Combined legend
    handles = l1 + l2 + [mpatches.Patch(facecolor='#D55E00', alpha=0.12,
                                         label='Structural collapse')]
    ax1.legend(handles=handles, loc='center right', frameon=True,
               framealpha=0.9, fontsize=7)

    ax1.set_title('ISR$^*$ Collapse vs. Prove-Rate Gain (exec-only, seed 42)')
    fig.tight_layout()
    save_both(fig, 'fig2_isr_collapse')


# =====================================================
# Fig 3: Hacking Composition Stacked Bar
# =====================================================
def fig3_hacking_composition():
    conditions = ['Exec-only\n(s42)',
                  'ISR β=0.1\n(mean s42/43/44)',
                  'Random β=0.1\n(mean s42/43/44)',
                  'ISR β=0.3\n(s42)',
                  'SFT\n(s42)']
    # Rows correspond to conditions; values are H1, H7, Genuine, Other (sum to 100)
    H1      = np.array([87.0, 20.0, 75.0, 78.0,  5.4])
    H7      = np.array([ 0.0, 64.5,  0.0,  0.0,  0.0])
    Genuine = np.array([13.0, 15.0, 25.0, 22.0, 92.9])
    # Other = 100 - sum (residual for rounding / unclassified)
    Other = 100.0 - (H1 + H7 + Genuine)
    Other = np.clip(Other, 0, None)

    x = np.arange(len(conditions))
    width = 0.6

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.0, 3.2))

    p1 = ax.bar(x, H1,      width, color=C_H1,      label='H1: conclusion embedding')
    p2 = ax.bar(x, H7,      width, bottom=H1, color=C_H7,
                label='H7: single premise')
    p3 = ax.bar(x, Genuine, width, bottom=H1 + H7, color=C_GENUINE,
                label='Genuine')
    p4 = ax.bar(x, Other,   width, bottom=H1 + H7 + Genuine, color=C_OTHER,
                label='Other')

    # In-bar value labels (only for segments >= 6%)
    def label_segment(values, bottoms, color='white'):
        for xi, (v, b) in enumerate(zip(values, bottoms)):
            if v >= 6:
                ax.text(xi, b + v / 2, f'{v:.0f}', ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=7, color=color, fontweight='bold')

    label_segment(H1,      np.zeros_like(H1),      color='white')
    label_segment(H7,      H1,                     color='black')
    label_segment(Genuine, H1 + H7,                color='white')
    label_segment(Other,   H1 + H7 + Genuine,      color='black')

    # Annotate low PR for ISR β=0.3
    ax.annotate('PR=18%\n(low)', xy=(3, 100), xytext=(3, 116),
                ha='center', fontsize=7, color='#555',
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#555', lw=0.6))

    # Highlight unique H7 hacking in ISR β=0.1
    ax.annotate('H7-only pathway\nunique to ISR β=0.1', xy=(1, 60),
                xytext=(1.55, 130), ha='left', fontsize=7, color=C_H7,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_H7, lw=0.7))

    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(conditions)
    ax.set_ylabel('Hacking-rate composition (%)')
    ax.set_ylim(0, 145)
    ax.set_yticks([0, 25, 50, 75, 100])
    ax.set_title('Composition of Reasoning Outcomes by Reward Configuration')
    ax.legend(loc='upper right', ncol=1, frameon=True, framealpha=0.9,
              fontsize=7, bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.92))
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.25, axis='y', zorder=0)

    fig.tight_layout()
    save_both(fig, 'fig3_hacking_composition')


# =====================================================
# Fig 4: Prolog Cross-Logic Comparison (2-panel)
# =====================================================
def fig4_prolog_cross_logic():
    seeds = ['s42', 's43', 's44']

    # Left panel: Exec-only ISR* (all < 0.1; use representative values below ceiling)
    exec_isr = np.array([0.08, 0.05, 0.07])

    # Right panel: STA Genuine Rate (all 0%) with hacking pathway annotations
    sta_genuine = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
    sta_pathways = ['100% H7', '97.4% H1', '97.9% H7\n(functional)']

    fig, (axL, axR) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(5.6, 2.8))

    # ----- Left: Exec-only ISR* -----
    xL = np.arange(len(seeds))
    axL.axhline(0.1, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.6)
    axL.text(2.45, 0.105, 'ISR*=0.1', fontsize=6.5, color='gray',
             ha='right', va='bottom')

    axL.scatter(xL, exec_isr, s=70, color=C_EXEC, edgecolor='black',
                linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)
    for xi, yi in zip(xL, exec_isr):
        axL.annotate(f'{yi:.2f}', (xi, yi), textcoords='offset points',
                     xytext=(0, 8), ha='center', fontsize=7)

    axL.set_xticks(xL)
    axL.set_xticklabels(seeds)
    axL.set_xlim(-0.5, len(seeds) - 0.5)
    axL.set_ylim(0, 0.35)
    axL.set_ylabel('ISR*')
    axL.set_xlabel('seed')
    axL.set_title('Prolog Exec-only\n(redundant ground facts)')
    axL.grid(True, alpha=0.25, axis='y', zorder=0)

    # ----- Right: STA Genuine Rate with pathway labels -----
    xR = np.arange(len(seeds))
    axR.scatter(xR, sta_genuine, s=70, color=C_STA, edgecolor='black',
                linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)
    for xi, yi, label in zip(xR, sta_genuine, sta_pathways):
        axR.annotate(label, (xi, yi), textcoords='offset points',
                     xytext=(0, 14), ha='center', fontsize=7, color='#333')
        axR.annotate(f'{yi:.0f}%', (xi, yi), textcoords='offset points',
                     xytext=(0, -15), ha='center', fontsize=7,
                     color=C_STA, fontweight='bold')

    axR.set_xticks(xR)
    axR.set_xticklabels(seeds)
    axR.set_xlim(-0.5, len(seeds) - 0.5)
    axR.set_ylim(-5, 60)
    axR.set_ylabel('Genuine reasoning rate (%)')
    axR.set_xlabel('seed')
    axR.set_title('Prolog STA\n(metric gaming pathways)')
    axR.grid(True, alpha=0.25, axis='y', zorder=0)

    fig.suptitle('Cross-Logic Failure: Both Variants Collapse on Prolog',
                 fontsize=10, y=1.02)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save_both(fig, 'fig4_prolog_cross_logic')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    fig2_isr_collapse()
    fig3_hacking_composition()
    fig4_prolog_cross_logic()
    print('All figures generated.')
